description: Finds a city or town and its coordinates, Indian places ranked first, from the same city list AstroCalc's kundli form uses. Useful before the birth-chart, matching or life-phase tools when a place name is ambiguous or misspelled (e.g. "Bombay", "Prayagraj", several towns with one name); pass the chosen label as place, or its lat and lon. Returns up to 5 matches with label, state, country, latitude and longitude.

lang.description: Language of the summary text: 'en' (default) or 'hi'.

query.description: Place name, optionally with state or country, e.g. 'Varanasi' or 'Aurangabad, Bihar'.

name: search_place
title: Find a birth place
